fullPassage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. The key questions are not simply "where" questions, though; they are "why there" and "so what" questions. Getting to such questions means taking spatial arrangements, variations, and interconnections seriously. Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some appreciation of spatial circumstances — where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like. Moving up in scale, without some awareness of ____________________, it is difficult to make reasoned business or policy judgments, make sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces shaping life on the planet. Locating a new store or public service requires taking into consideration population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more. Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of discrimination, socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.

③ (A) 규모 — (B) 비늘: (B)에서 C major scale은 음악 용어이므로 '비늘'은 부적절
④ (A) 저울 — (B) 음계: (A)에서 측정 도구(저울)와는 무관
det.tip: scale은 다의어: (A) 공간적 규모/범위, (B) 음악에서의 음계.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a statement or idea that is accepted as true and that is used as the basis of an argument or theory"

det.korean: 진실로 받아들여지며 주장이나 이론의 기초로 사용되는 진술 또는 개념
det.analysis:
① outcome: 결과 — 기초가 아닌 끝 단계
② evidence: 증거 — 기초로 사용될 수 있지만 '진실로 받아들여지는 진술' 자체는 아님
③ experiment: 실험 — 검증 과정이지 전제가 아님
④ premise: 전제 — 이론/주장의 기초가 되는 전제 ←정답
det.tip: premise는 본문에서 'geography starts from the premise that...'(지리학은 ~라는 전제에서 시작한다)로 사용되었다.

questions.passage: Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some __________ of spatial circumstances — where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like. (appreciate)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: some __________(appreciate) of spatial circumstances — some 뒤에 명사가 필요. appreciate(동사)를 명사형 appreciation으로 변환.
det.tip: some appreciation of spatial circumstances — 공간적 상황에 대한 인식. appreciate → appreciation(명사).

questions.passage: Without some awareness, it is difficult to make reasoned business or policy judgments, make sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces __________ life on the planet. (shape)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: the basic forces __________(shape) life — forces를 수식하는 현재분사가 필요. shape(동사)를 현재분사 shaping으로 변환. forces와 shape 사이의 능동 관계.
det.tip: the basic forces shaping life on the planet — 지구 위 삶을 형성하는 기본적 힘들. shape → shaping(현재분사/능동).

questions.passage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. The key questions are not simply "where" questions, though; they are "why there" and "so what" questions. Getting to such questions means taking spatial arrangements, variations, and interconnections seriously. Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some appreciation of spatial __________ — where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like. Moving up in scale, without some awareness of ____________________, it is difficult to make reasoned business or policy judgments, make sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces shaping life on the planet. Locating a new store or public service requires taking into consideration population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more. Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of discrimination, socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가장 단순한 일상 활동에도 공간적 ___에 대한 인식이 필요하다 — 음식과 서비스를 어디서 찾을지, 직장에 어떻게 갈지 등.
det.analysis:
① regulations: 규정 — 일상 활동의 맥락과 불일치
② preferences: 선호 — 본문은 '여건/상황'을 말함
③ circumstances: 여건/상황 — 공간적 여건에 대한 인식이 필요하다는 원문 맥락 ←정답
④ predictions: 예측 — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: some appreciation of spatial circumstances — 공간적 여건/상황에 대한 인식. 음식·서비스 찾기, 출근 경로 등 일상의 공간적 맥락.

det.korean: 이주의 이유와 장소를 이해하려면 영토의 정치적 조직, 차별의 ___, 사회경제적 패턴, 물리적 환경의 배치를 고려해야 한다.
det.analysis:
① spatial consequences: 공간적 결과 — 차별이 공간적으로 어떤 결과를 낳는지 ←정답

③ historical records: 역사적 기록 — 본문 맥락과 불일치
④ legal definitions: 법적 정의 — 본문에 언급 없음
det.tip: the spatial consequences of discrimination — 차별의 공간적 결과. 이주를 이해하기 위한 핵심 고려 요소.
